candidates.rationale: Paul models forgetting what lies behind and straining forward, showing grace toward past choices while pressing on.
Paul reflects on his own childish ways without condemnation, acknowledging growth and change over time.
Paul extends compassion to his own conflicted past actions, recognizing the gap between intention and execution.
God instructs not to dwell on former things, inviting a posture of moving forward rather than self-condemnation over the past.
The old has passed away and the new has come, offering a framework for viewing one's earlier self with grace as part of transformation.
